text:
Cash consideration of $88.82 per share plus stock consideration in Parent Common Stock equal to the Exchange Ratio (Merger Consideration Value = Cash Consideration + (Parent Share Price × Exchange Ratio)).
Cash Consideration: 88.82 per share; Share Consideration: number of Parent Common Stock equal to Exchange Ratio; Fractional Share Cash Amount; Equity Award Exchange Ratio; Cash-Out RSU Consideration; Cash-Out Phantom Stock Unit Consideration.
Fixed Exchange Ratio is 1.0 per Company Common Stock. Equity Award Exchange Ratio means (a) the Exchange Ratio, plus (b) the quotient of (i) the Cash Consideration divided by (ii) the Parent Share Price, rounded to the nearest one thousandth. For each share outstanding, the Company is converted into (A) a number of shares of Parent Common Stock equal to the Exchange Ratio (the "Share Consideration"), and (B) $88.82 in cash (the "Cash Consideration"), with the two together constituting the Merger Consideration.
